svg.text: SEED3 SOCKET BOARD - the BACK (solder side), seen from INSIDE the box. Scale 4:1
Face (top of the pedal) is UP. USB-C end / footswitches on the LEFT. IN jack end on the RIGHT.
Pin 1 = D0 (not used). Snip pin 1 off the Seed3 and push a snipped resistor leg into socket 1 (glue it):
now the Seed3 only goes in the right way round. Backwards would put 9 V on the wrong pins!
Each wire is soldered to the end of the ~9 mm header leg with the SAME pin number shown here, under 6 mm of heat shrink.
Red = widen that grid hole to 3.2 mm (outer grid columns, 1st and 9th row: 58.4 x 20.3 mm apart). 4 screws: M3x12 from outside | wall | 5 mm spacer | board | nut.
Sockets go in the 2nd and 8th row from the face-side edge, 2 empty columns at each end. They're soldered, so they stay when the Seed3 is pulled.
